source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: When a melee attack destroys this model while it has not yet fought in this phase, roll a D6. On a 2+, leave it in play; once the attacking unit is done attacking, this model can fight. If its attacks then destroy at least one enemy model, it survives and regains D3 lost wounds; if they destroy none, it is then removed from play.

ability.trigger: this model is destroyed by a melee attack
ability.condition: this model has not fought this phase
